# IBM Db2 TechX Summit 2026 — Project Submission

## 1. Project Overview

- Project Title: SurplusSync — Predictive Community Food Rescue
- Project Slug: surplussync
- Short Description: SurplusSync connects food donors with suitable NGOs, shelters and community centres through recipient matching, explainable feasibility checks and coordinated rescue planning.
- Problem Solved: Edible surplus food is wasted while nearby communities need meals. SurplusSync helps donors, recipient organisations and volunteers coordinate timely food rescue.

## 2. Team Information

- Team Name: HyperX
- Participation: Individual
- Contributor: Rajat Rajput
- GitHub: @rajatrajput2402
- Role: Creator and Developer

## 3. IBM Db2 Integration Summary

- Db2 Edition: IBM Db2 Community Edition using a local Podman container.
- Usage: Additional storage and retrieval of food-listing analysis snapshots and candidate evaluation records.
- Connector: Python ibm_db driver.
- Table: SURPLUSSYNC_AI_RECORDS
- API Endpoints:
  - GET /api/ai/db2/status
  - POST /api/ai/db2/analyze

Verification Status:
The local Db2 container was started and its host port was reachable. However, application-level Db2 connectivity and successful snapshot read-back are not yet verified.

## 4. Technology Stack & AI / LLM Usage

- Languages: Python, JavaScript
- Backend: FastAPI
- Frontend: React + Vite
- Operational Database: SQLite
- Additional Database: IBM Db2
- AI Framework: LangChain Core and langchain-ibm
- Model Provider: IBM watsonx.ai Granite (optional)

AI Workflow:
LangChain uses retrieved Db2 records as context for explanations. The implementation supports an optional watsonx.ai generation path and a deterministic rules-only fallback.

Watsonx credentials are not configured. Actual model generation remains unverified.

## 5. Demonstration & Links

- Live Demo: Not provided
- Demo Video: Not provided
- Source Repository: https://github.com/rajatrajput2402/SurplusSync
- Submission Source: Included in submissions/surplussync/src/

## 6. Submission Verification Checklist

- [x] Folder Structure
- [x] Naming Conventions
- [x] Complete Documentation
- [x] Valid submission.json
- [x] No real secrets or credentials committed
- [ ] Tested setup from a fresh environment
- [ ] License declared
- [ ] Code of Conduct confirmation
- [x] Scope isolation
- [ ] Google Form submission

## 7. Additional Notes for Reviewers & Judges

SQLite remains the operational source of truth. IBM Db2 is intended as an additional analysis data store.

The matching engine evaluates recipient availability, food category, configured capacity, pickup deadlines and estimated travel time. Rescue plans include explainable candidate rankings and rejection reasons.

Travel estimates are illustrative. Human food-safety checks remain necessary. The rules-based risk score is not a trained machine-learning prediction model.

Live Db2 application connectivity and watsonx generation have not yet been verified. These limitations are explicitly documented.
